Action.description: The actions a rule can name.
Action.title: Action

AggregateKey.description: A key across aggregates, as the runtime reads it from the schema: no two aggregate roots of one class in a tenant's database hold the same values for its predicates.

key_name.description: The name of a key across aggregates, as declared in `unique_keys`.

key_predicates.description: The predicates of the key's slots, in the order of the key.

root_class.description: The IRI of the class of the aggregate roots the key governs; a root of a subclass is its own scope.

AggregateKey.title: AggregateKey

AggregateRoot.description: A mixin for classes whose instances are aggregate roots. Each instance is one named graph, whose IRI is derived from the root's IRI; it is versioned, loaded and saved as a whole.
AggregateRoot.title: AggregateRoot

BlobEntry.description: One object in a tenant's bucket, as a listing of the bucket reports it.
BlobEntry.title: BlobEntry

Book.description: A book held by a library; an aggregate root that owns its chapters.

authors.description: The names of the book's authors.

chapters.description: The chapters of the book; they live in the book's graph.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

genre.description: The literary genre of the book.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

isbn.description: The International Standard Book Number of the book.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

published.description: The date the book was published.

sequel_of.description: The book this one follows, another aggregate, stored as its IRI.

shelf.description: The shelf the book stands on, another aggregate, stored as its IRI.

Book.title: Book

Chapter.description: A chapter of a book, known by its number rather than a label; part of the book's aggregate. It owns its notes.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

notes.description: The notes on a chapter; they live in the book's graph.

number.description: The position of a chapter in its book.

Chapter.title: Chapter

Comment.description: A remark on an aggregate, or a reply to another remark. Each comment is an aggregate root of its own, whose target is always the aggregate it is about; a reply also names the comment it answers. The toolkit writes and reads it, since its audience limits who may see it. The session writes its author and time as the tracking of its graph.

comment_audience.description: The names of the roles that may see the comment; none means everyone who may read the aggregate.

comment_references.description: The IRIs of other aggregates the comment points to.

has_target.description: The IRI of the aggregate the comment is about.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

motivated_by.description: Why the comment was made, a remark or a reply.

replies_to.description: The IRI of the comment this one answers.

Comment.title: Comment

CommitMarker.description: The registry marker of one transaction's commit: a fresh IRI per transaction, written first in the single request, so the writes that follow apply only if it was written.

id.description: A fresh urn:uuid IRI, never shared by two transactions.

CommitMarker.title: CommitMarker

DatabaseKind.description: The databases an aggregate can live in, the values of the database annotation.
DatabaseKind.title: DatabaseKind

Described.description: A mixin giving an object an IRI, a label and a description. The application writes them.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

Described.title: Described

Genre.description: The literary genres a book can belong to.
Genre.title: Genre

Grant.description: A permission given to a principal on a tenant or on one aggregate, either by role or as a direct action; exactly one of role and action is given.

action.description: The action a direct permission allows, or a prohibition forbids.

assignee.description: The principal the rule applies to.

role.description: The name of a role, matched against the application's role definitions.

target.description: The IRI of the tenant, or of an aggregate's graph, the rule applies to.

Grant.title: Grant

GraphKind.description: The special graphs a class can live in, the values of the graph annotation.
GraphKind.title: GraphKind

KeyDuplicate.description: A set of aggregate roots of one class that hold the same values for a key across aggregates, found in a tenant's database by the duplicates report.

key_name.description: The name of a key across aggregates, as declared in `unique_keys`.

key_roots.description: The IRIs of the roots that hold the values, sorted.

key_values.description: The lexical forms of the shared values, in the order of the key.

root_class.description: The IRI of the class of the roots.

KeyDuplicate.title: KeyDuplicate

Library.description: A library; the tenant root. Its IRI is the tenant IRI and it lives in the tenant's meta graph.

city.description: The city where the library is located.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

Library.title: Library

LibraryAccess.description: The access record of a library tenant; its grants are the metamodel's.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

grants.description: The permissions given in the tenant, by role or as direct actions; they live in the access record's graph.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

prohibitions.description: The actions forbidden in the tenant; they live in the access record's graph.

state.description: Where the tenant is in its life.

LibraryAccess.title: LibraryAccess

MembershipRule.description: The rule of a collection, a part of its graph with no identifier of its own. An aggregate belongs when it equals every equality; a rule with no equality means every aggregate of the member class.

rule_equalities.description: The conditions of the rule, all of which an aggregate must meet.

MembershipRule.title: MembershipRule

ModuleKind.description: The kinds of schema module, the values of the module_kind annotation.
ModuleKind.title: ModuleKind

Note.description: A short note on a chapter, with a label of its own.

about.description: The book a note is about, another aggregate, stored as its IRI.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

shade.description: The colour of the note's paper.

Note.title: Note

PendingLoad.description: The registry marker of a load not yet committed: one triple saying when the graph was put. It names no registry entry, so deleting it never deletes an entry.

id.description: The IRI of the graph the load put; the marker's subject, so no rp:graph triple.

loaded_at.description: The time a graph was put to the store by a load.

PendingLoad.title: PendingLoad

Policy.description: A set of permissions and prohibitions.
Policy.title: Policy

Principal.description: A reference to a user account in the identity provider, by IRI only.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

Principal.title: Principal

Prohibition.description: The ODRL prohibition that forbids an assignee an action on a target; it wins over any permission.

action.description: The action a direct permission allows, or a prohibition forbids.

assignee.description: The principal the rule applies to.

target.description: The IRI of the tenant, or of an aggregate's graph, the rule applies to.

Prohibition.title: Prohibition

RdfFormat.description: The serialisations a file of RDF can be loaded from.
RdfFormat.title: RdfFormat

ReferenceCollection.description: A mixin for an aggregate that collects other aggregates of one class: the members it names, and a rule that says which aggregates of that class belong. A collection of collections has the collection class as its member class.

had_member.description: The IRIs of the aggregates the collection names as its members.

member_class.description: The schema name of the class of the aggregates the collection collects.

membership_rule.description: The rule that says which aggregates of the member class belong to the collection.

ReferenceCollection.title: ReferenceCollection

RegistryEntry.description: An entry of a tenant's registry graph, naming a graph that belongs to an aggregate. It is written by the session, never by the application.

graph.description: The IRI of a named graph.

kind.description: The kind of graph a registry entry names.

owned_by.description: The IRI of the aggregate root that owns the graph.

RegistryEntry.title: RegistryEntry

RegistryKind.description: The kinds of graph a registry entry can name.
RegistryKind.title: RegistryKind

RoleDefinition.description: What a role may do and where it applies. An application supplies its role definitions as data; they are not stored.

role.description: The name of a role, matched against the application's role definitions.

RoleDefinition.title: RoleDefinition

RoleLevel.description: The levels at which a role applies.
RoleLevel.title: RoleLevel

RpAnnotation.description: The annotations the toolkit reads from a schema, one entry per tag; any other tag is left alone. Each description says which element carries the tag and which values it accepts.
RpAnnotation.title: RpAnnotation

Rule.description: An ODRL rule that gives an assignee a ruling on an action over a target.

action.description: The action a direct permission allows, or a prohibition forbids.

assignee.description: The principal the rule applies to.

target.description: The IRI of the tenant, or of an aggregate's graph, the rule applies to.

Rule.title: Rule

Scan.description: A scanned copy of a book; an aggregate root whose current content is a stored file.

byte_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

file_name.description: The name of the file as uploaded.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

media_type.description: The media type of the file.

scan_of.description: The book this is a scan of, another aggregate, stored as its IRI.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the file, in lowercase hexadecimal.

uploaded.description: The time the file was uploaded.

uploaded_by.description: The principal that uploaded the file.

Scan.title: Scan

Shelf.description: A shelf of the library; an aggregate root that books are placed on, and a collection of the books it names.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

had_member.description: The IRIs of the aggregates the collection names as its members.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

member_class.description: The schema name of the class of the aggregates the collection collects.

membership_rule.description: The rule that says which aggregates of the member class belong to the collection.

Shelf.title: Shelf

SlotEquality.description: One condition of a membership rule, a slot of the member class and the value it must equal.

equals_slot.description: The name of the slot of the member class the condition looks at.

equals_value.description: The value the slot must equal, in the lexical form a listing filter would send.

SlotEquality.title: SlotEquality

StoredFile.description: A mixin for the current content of a kept file; the bytes live in the tenant's bucket under the file key.

byte_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.description: The name of the file as uploaded.

media_type.description: The media type of the file.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the file, in lowercase hexadecimal.

uploaded.description: The time the file was uploaded.

uploaded_by.description: The principal that uploaded the file.

StoredFile.title: StoredFile

TenantAccess.description: The access record of a tenant: its label, state and database name, with the grants and prohibitions that say who may do what in it.

description.description: A free-text description of the object.

grants.description: The permissions given in the tenant, by role or as direct actions; they live in the access record's graph.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

prohibitions.description: The actions forbidden in the tenant; they live in the access record's graph.

state.description: Where the tenant is in its life.

TenantAccess.title: TenantAccess

TenantLabelled.description: A mixin for what carries a tenant's label, one line of 1 to 200 characters that neither starts nor ends in a space; the access record and the service's request bodies share it, so the label is checked the same everywhere.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

TenantLabelled.title: TenantLabelled

TenantSweepReport.description: The outcome of a sweep of one live tenant: the loaded graphs and bucket objects found orphaned past the grace period, and whether each list was removed.

blobs.description: The keys of the orphaned bucket objects found, sorted.

loaded_graphs.description: The IRIs of the orphaned loaded graphs found, sorted.

older_than_seconds.description: The grace period in seconds; only what is older is reported.

removed_blobs.description: Whether the orphaned bucket objects were removed.

removed_loaded_graphs.description: Whether the orphaned loaded graphs were removed.

skipped_blobs.description: The keys of orphaned objects the object store would not delete.

TenantSweepReport.title: TenantSweepReport

Tracked.description: A mixin for the tracking statements of a commit. The session writes them about the aggregate's graph IRI, never about the root entity.
Tracked.title: Tracked

UniqueScope.description: The scopes of a key across aggregates, the values of the rp_unique_scope annotation.
UniqueScope.title: UniqueScope

WritesKind.description: How an aggregate root is written, the values of the rp_writes annotation.
WritesKind.title: WritesKind
